title: Build the repository-backed Mez Systems Figma companion
objective: Create a dedicated Figma companion that mirrors the approved foundations, identity, expressions and component contracts without giving Figma independent design authority.

included: approve the read-only Phase 0 inventory, proposed scope and conflict resolutions
create a new dedicated Mez Systems Figma companion after the Phase 0 gate
generate variables and styles from canonical repository values
mirror canonical expression and component contracts with exact static authoring twins where runtime behaviour cannot execute
document patterns, journeys, Golden Homepage composition, accessibility and repository traceability
audit naming, modes, variants, detach behaviour and source parity before a final human gate
plan Code Connect only after the library structure is approved
excluded: editing the historical Mez Systems branding file
inventing values, anatomy, motion or product identity in Figma
promoting research, killed directions or candidate-only experiments
reimplementing live WebGL, video, halftone or marquee runtimes in Figma
consumer repository work, publishing, deployment or production release

acceptance: every mirrored Figma value and component links to a canonical repository contract
the exact Figma file key, page structure, variable collections, modes, styles and components are inventoried
fluid typography, five colour modes, responsive rules and runtime-only behaviour retain honest documented boundaries
the historical file remains unchanged and no external library becomes Mez authority
validation records source parity, accessibility, naming and known gaps

deliverables.path: new dedicated Mez Systems Figma companion file
acceptance: variables, styles, components and documentation are organised for practical authoring
the file identifies its mirrored repository revision and never claims independent authority
all canonical modes and approved variants are represented without reviving killed or research-only directions

verification.passCondition: the repository inventory and exported Figma inventory agree on values, modes, roles, components and version references
variables, styles, components, variants and documentation are usable, named consistently and free from historical or external authority drift
contrast, focus representations, content resizing guidance, static equivalence and annotation semantics preserve canonical accessibility boundaries
Olli first approves Phase 0 scope, then separately approves the completed Figma companion

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Approve the completed repository-backed Figma companion structure as the authoring mirror for the Mez Systems design system?

stopConditions: Phase 0 scope has not been explicitly approved
a Figma value cannot be traced to canonical repository authority
the work would edit the historical branding file or reuse an unrelated external library
a runtime-only behaviour is represented as if it executes in Figma
research, candidate or killed work would be promoted without its own gate
the task expands into channels, consumer integration, publishing or deployment
notes: Phase 0 discovery is complete and made zero Figma mutations; Olli approved H-FIG-01-FIGMA-COMPANION-SCOPE on 28 July 2026.
The recommended target is a new dedicated file; the historical HU0GVaDhatjWrKCiSg3wlU file remains research-only.
The approved rc.1 package remains a frozen milestone and is not rebuilt by this task.

The new dedicated companion file is QxZT3FJ8BDXOZfBQDt0qPW. Phase 1 foundations passed live audit with 255 variables, 215 valid aliases, fifteen text styles and five depth styles. Phase 2 added four visually inspected documentation pages with zero missing fonts. Phase 3 added six rendered identity/expression component sets with 29 variants and zero missing fonts. Phase 4 added eighteen rendered functional component sets with 105 variants, zero missing fonts and an 18-of-18 detach pass. Gate B passed at 67/75.

Olli approved the completed companion at H-FIG-02-FIGMA-COMPANION-APPROVAL on 28 July 2026. The approved result is a Figma authoring mirror, not independent canonical authority, a published library, production Code Connect, a consumer integration or a release.
